prompt: When holding the Crescent Axe from Demon's Souls (2009) in two hands, what is the physical damage reduction when blocking?
answer: The Crescent Axe has **55% physical damage reduction when blocking**, even when held in two hands. It also has **10% magic damage reduction** and **40 guard-break reduction**.
